# Stylized Water 3 source notice

This directory contains formula-provenance records for Galacean adaptations of depth-response behavior from Stylized Water 3 version 3.2.7. It is not an active Ocean runtime or asset directory, and it retains no vendor binary assets.

The project owner has attested that written authorization permitting use and adaptation of the referenced source behavior is held privately. The authorization text is intentionally not included here. This notice does not extend to any Stylized Water 3 source or asset not identified by the provenance record.

The referenced source behavior remains attributable to Staggart Creations. Original editor source, editor metadata, profiles, textures, terrain derivatives, and unrelated package content are not shipped. Galacean ports are separate, traceable adaptations and do not remove or replace the vendor attribution or authorization boundary.
